comparisons.scope: Same original BF16/TP2/B4/context2048/standard sampler/native inputs and exact output budgets. Both exact-commit packaged variants use floor2048; only the candidate enables NKI cache movement. Both clients use the same600s socket wait with unchanged requests and output budgets. Three rounds per workload, sequential reference then candidate; no randomized-order or significance claim.

exact_reversible_edits.before: Reference uses the min2048 workaround; candidate uses natural bucket selection with NKI cache movement.
exact_reversible_edits.after: Both exact-commit packaged variants use floor2048; only the candidate enables NKI cache movement.

mixed_lengths.note: Closed-loop client: replace each completed request until 16 finish. Client worker queue time is excluded from per-request latency; aggregate elapsed includes all work. Streaming TTFT is time to first nonempty decoded text chunk, not device first-token latency. p95 uses nearest rank. Mixed cases intentionally reuse slots across different lengths.
